create_JoystickGaitTracking: create a JoystickGaitTracking environment with default config for Spot locomotion with gait control
run_JoystickGaitTracking_reset: run the JoystickGaitTracking reset method to initialize the simulation state with sampled gait parameters
run_JoystickGaitTracking_step: run the JoystickGaitTracking step method to advance the simulation with motor target actions
build_default_config: build the default config for JoystickGaitTracking with reward scales, command ranges, and gait frequency settings
test_sample_command: test the sample_command method to generate random linear and angular velocity commands for Spot
